title: Managed lists for service areas and case categories
summary: Admins can now manage APES CIC ticket service areas and case categories one row at a time. Rows already used by tickets or cases are archived rather than deleted.
changes: Add a row-by-row screen for ticket service areas and case categories, linked from plugin settings.
Admins can add, rename, reorder, archive, restore and delete rows.
Rows used by existing tickets or cases are archived: they leave new forms but older records keep their label.
Reset to defaults still restores the original lists.
version_rationale: Minor: starts the v0.48 plugin settings epic with a new admin capability; stored settings keep their shape, with an optional archived flag.
validation: New feature test for adding, renaming, reordering, deleting, archiving, restoring and resetting rows.
Ticket, case, plugin settings, admin route denial and architecture tests.
known_limitations: Subcategories are still edited in the plugin settings form. Shelter and Pet Care ticket areas follow in a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Archived rows would show on forms again until re-archived; no data is lost.
provenance: Milestone v0.48.3 Beta, issue #471 under epic #470, pull request #598.
